tables.description: Recorded customer cash receipts in UZS. Sum amount by payment_date. Includes bank transfer, cash desk and corporate card unless the question specifies one method. Attribute a receipt to its branch through invoices.branch_id. A payment is always positive. Refunds and returns are not recorded in this dataset. Report the missing source when asked for refunds or amounts net of refunds; cancelled orders cannot measure returned cash.
tables.grain: One received payment per id. One invoice can have multiple payments.

tables.description: Order amounts and cost of goods sold in UZS by order_date. Completed orders use status = 'completed'. For dashboard sales all statuses except 'cancelled' contribute. Gross profit is SUM(total_amount - total_cost) over the requested order population. Gross margin percent is 100 * gross profit / NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0). For net profit use the separate pnl_expenses source over the same scope and period. Order value and cash received have different amounts and dates. Refunds are unavailable.
tables.grain: One order per id, with branch_id. Aggregate order amounts before joining one-to-many details.

tables.description: One discounted sale line per product. For product-level revenue use SUM(order_items.total_amount) on completed orders. Gross profit is SUM(total_amount - quantity * cost_price); gross margin percent is 100.0 times this profit divided by NULLIF(SUM(total_amount), 0). Group by products.id and name. Join orders by order_id for completion status and order date. Join products by product_id and product_categories by products.category_id. A multi-product invoice or payment does not allocate cash to a SKU.
tables.grain: One product line per id, many lines per order.

tables.description: Product directory, with physical IT equipment identified by its product category. Use products.name to identify an individual product, products.sku for its SKU and products.category_id to look up the type. Current list prices and catalog costs are not the historical sale price and cost.
tables.grain: One product per id and SKU.

tables.description: Product types are named in product_categories.name. In this enterprise sample the physical IT equipment categories have codes CAT-SRV (servers), CAT-NET (network), CAT-STO (storage), CAT-SEC (security appliances), CAT-PWR (power and racks), CAT-CLI (workstations/laptops), and CAT-CAB (passive network, optics and cable). These codes define hardware for this source.

Recorded operating expenses in UZS by expense_date. Dashboard net profit = non-cancelled order revenue minus cost of goods sold minus recorded operating expenses. Aggregate orders and expenses separately at the same grain before subtraction. There is no overhead allocation key for products and no separate tax or financing expense fact; explain these limits when requested. Product-level gross profit is available.
tables.grain: One recorded expense entry per id, assigned to one branch and department.

tables.description: Current reconciliation balance in UZS per client contract. balance_receivable is the current amount still owed. overdue_receivable is the overdue portion. total_invoiced and invoices.total_amount are billed amounts before payments and cannot answer an outstanding-balance question. last_reconciliation_date is the latest check, not a ledger of historical balances.
tables.grain: One current reconciliation record per client and contract.

tables.description: Branch directory. Group separate branches by id and show name as the display label.
